# 🔥 Linkedin Companies & Profiles Bulk Scraper

The Apify actor [`bebity/linkedin-premium-actor`](https://apify.com/bebity/linkedin-premium-actor) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.301**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Companies & Profiles Linkedin scraper.
Get comprehensive profiles of individuals and companies based on your keywords and filters.
Unleash the power of data! 🌐🔍

## Pricing

Pay per event — Actor Start $0.00005, Profile — identity & current position $0.003, Experience & Education — full career history $0.002, Profile section — pay only for the data you need $0.001, Company — full company page $0.003 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/bebity/linkedin-premium-actor) for current prices.

```yaml
imports:
```

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |

| `headline` | string \| null | Profile professional headline (job title and tagline shown under the name). |

| `location` | string \| null | Geographic location displayed on the profile. |
| `industry` | string \| null | Industry label — of the profile, or of the company. Shared field name across both output types. |
